In the following reactions, P,Q,R, and S are the major products.

The correct statement(s) about P,Q,R, and S is(are)
options: P and Q are monomers of polymers dacron and glyptal, respectively.
P, Q, and R are dicarboxylic acids.
Compounds <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="bold">Q</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="bold">R</mi></math> are the same.
R does not undergo aldol condensation and S does not undergo Cannizzaro reaction.
questions.solution:
Toluene part of the reactant in the first reaction undergoes oxidation with KMnO4, forms benzoic acid. In this conversion, alkyl part of toluene converts into carboxylic group. So, P is a monocarboxylic acid.

Both ester and acid halides undergo hydrolysis to give carboxylic acid. Hence, the product Q is the dicarboxylic acid. And it is known as isophthalic acid.

In the third reaction, ester undergo hydrolysis in the first step, which results beta keto acid. Beta keto acids are unstable. They liberate carbon dioxide on heating. The alpha methyl ketone formed undergo oxidation with chromic acid give carboxylic acid. Hence, R is also isophthalic acid.

In the fourth reaction, the bromo part reacts with magnesium metal to give Grignard reagent. Grignard reagent give carboxylic acid upon reaction with carbon dioxide. Now during the hydrolysis of previous step acetal cleavage takes place and gives aldehyde functional group. This aldehyde converts to carboxylic acid with Tollen's reagent. This results the terephthalic acid.

The products R and S are dicarboxylic acids and does not undergo Aldol condensation reaction or Cannizzaro's reaction.

questions.solution:
I3+ ion has sp3 hybridisation and bent shape containing two bond pairs and two lone pairs. Structure of SiO44− is tetrahedral structure and Si is sp3 hybridised. The molecular geometry of SOCl2 is trigonal pyramidal and its electron geometry is tetrahedral. In this molecule sulphur undergo sp3 hbridisation,

XeF2 molecule is linear molecule but it is sp3d hybridised. In SF4, sulphur undergo sp3d hybridisation and molecule has see-saw shape. In ClF3, chlorine undergo sp3d hybridisation and shape of the molecule is T-shape.

The nickel tetracarbonyl is a tetrahedral complex in which nickel metal undergo sp3 hybridisation. In the molecule XeO2F2, Xe undergo sp3d hybridisation and molecular shape is see-saw. Tetrachloroplatinate(II) is a square planar complex in which platinum undergoes dsp2 hbridisation.

XeF4 is square planar compound in which xenon undergoes sp3d2 hybridisation. In the tetrahedral molecule SO2Cl2, sulphur undergoes sp3 hybridisation.

Hence, the total number of sp3 hybridised central atom molecules are 5.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements related to colloids.

(I) Lyophobic colloids are not formed by simple mixing of dispersed phase and dispersion medium.

(II) For emulsions, both the dispersed phase and the dispersion medium are liquid.

(III) Micelles are produced by dissolving a surfactant in any solvent at any temperature.

(IV) Tyndall effect can be observed from a colloidal solution with dispersed phase having the same refractive index as that of the dispersion medium.

The option with the correct set of statements is
questions.solution:
As in Lyophobic colloids there is no interaction between dispersed phase and dispersion medium, special methods are used for preparation, simple mixing will not form colloid.

Emulsion are colloids of liquid dispersed phase and liquid dispersion medium.

Micelles formation occurs when temperature is above a particular temperature called Kraft temperature TK and concentration above a particular value know as critical micelle concentration (CMC).

Tyndall's effect can be observed when the refractive indices of the dispersed phase and the dispersion medium differ greatly in magnitude.

A thin circular coin of mass 5 gm and radius 43 cm is initially in a horizontal xy-plane. The coin is tossed vertically up (+z direction) by applying an impulse of π2×10-2 N-s at a distance 23 cm from its center. The coin spins about its diameter and moves along the +z direction. By the time the coin reaches back to its initial position, it completes n rotations. The value of n is _____.

[Given: The acceleration due to gravity g=10 m s−2]
questions.solution:
By impulse - momentum theorem:

J=MVCM

⇒ VCM=JM=π2100×51000=2π m s-1

⇒ Total time of journey =2VCMg=2g×2π

⇒ ∆t=2π5 s

Also, by angular impulse- momentum theorem:

J×R2=Iω⇒J×R2=MR24ω

⇒ ω=J×R2MR24=JMR×2

=π2100×251000×43×1100

=1502π rad s-1

⇒ Number of rotations =ω∆t2π

=1502π×2π52π=30

Therefore, n=30.

questions.q: An ideal gas is in thermodynamic equilibrium. The number of degrees of freedom of a molecule of the gas is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math>. The internal energy of one mole of the gas is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>U</mi><mi>n</mi></msub></math> and the speed of sound in the gas is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>v</mi><mi>n</mi></msub></math>. At a fixed temperature and pressure, which of the following is the correct option?
questions.solution:
As we know, internal energy of one mole of the gas Un=nRT2.

Clearly, Un∝n, where n is degree of freedom. Therefore, as n increases, Un also increases.

Now, speed of sound in gas

vn=γRTM=1+2nRTM

Clearly, as n increases and vn decreases.

Hence,

U7>U5 and U7>U6

and v5>v7.
